They nailed the physics in this one. You can really feel the front lose grip, and you have plenty to fishtail and control it out of corners. The VR is an amazing experience, the graphics are so good now that it truly makes you feel like you are in the car. The shine off your car, the shine from your tires and others, wet roads..and the details are amazing. Also animated pitcrew that looks great helps too. I played for 6 hours straight last night, I can't remember a driving game kept me hooked like this. I am talking GPL level physics in this F1 game, 10/10. Please keep this up for future F1 games, and please work on putting some seat controls in for VR (seat up, down, back, front etc). This game runs better in VR than LMU does, and uses about 10Gig of VRAM. Would definitely buy it again! I give it a 9/10 overall, because the menu system is a pain and not made well for PC, you have to frequently grab your keyboard to hit F5,F6 in menu to make car changes & play game. As someone who used F1 20, 21, 23, 24 and now 25, the downforce era will always have a place in my heart but the my team is WAY better now, as well as the driving mechanics, Traction mechanics (or in my case lack thereof), and I cannot exaggerate how good the LiDAR tracks are compared to their handmade ones, and the driver details are amazing. Overall the driver selection for icons is a bit depressing and the APXGP cutscenes are barely visible but otherwise the graphics and gameplay are by far just way beyond all else.

F1 25 is basically the best one yet because they finally changed the way the cars drive so it feels way more realistic and not just like you're sliding on ice the whole time. The biggest part of the game is My Team 2.0 which is sick because you get to be the actual boss and choose two real drivers for your team instead of just being one driver. You have to manage the money and pick which driver gets the new car parts first, and you can even choose which one you want to play as for each race. They also added reverse tracks for the first time so you can drive Silverstone and Zandvoort backwards which is super confusing but fun to try. The tracks look way better too because they used lasers to scan them so you feel every single bump in the road. There is a cool story mode called Braking Point 3 where you follow Aiden Jackson and Devon Butler again, and you can even play as characters from the new F1 movie. If you have a VR headset like a Quest it feels like you're actually in the car and it's awesome.

F125 Review
English
F125 is an exhilarating racing game designed to bring players the thrill of high-speed racing. The game offers a refreshing experience in terms of graphics and physics engine, making every drive filled with excitement.

Graphics and Visuals
F125 features stunning visuals, with highly detailed tracks and environment designs. The lighting effects and vehicle models are finely crafted, providing a high level of immersion for players.

Gameplay Mechanics
The controls are smooth, providing an excellent driving feel. Players can experience the distinct driving styles of various vehicles, facing challenges whether speeding on straightaways or navigating sharp turns. Additionally, the upgrade system and customization options allow players to adjust vehicle performance according to their preferences.

Sound Effects and Music
In terms of sound, F125 excels with its engine noises and ambient effects, enhancing realism. The background music is upbeat and engaging, making it easier to immerse oneself in the race.

Community and Competitive Scene
F125 boasts an active player community that frequently hosts various events and challenges, enhancing the game's replayability. The competition among players adds an extra layer of fun.

Conclusion
Overall, F125 is a high-quality racing game that excels in graphics, gameplay, and community involvement, making it a must-try for racing game enthusiasts.
